Insurance revenue less insurance service expenses is within 0.5 percent of the printed insurance service result, which is stored as Gross Profit; that result plus investment income less other operating expenses gives the printed loss before taxation. Income tax is the difference between the printed loss before taxation and the printed loss for the period, the filing printing no separate tax line. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move.
